auto_register_tags: auto register layer tags in a JAX function by tracing it and matching graph patterns
build_jax_graph: build a JaxprGraph from a JAX function, its arguments, and parameter indices for pattern matching
match_pattern: match a GraphPattern against a JaxprGraph starting from a root equation to find layer structures
find_layer_tags_and_patterns: find all automatic layer tag matches in a JaxprGraph using a set of predefined graph patterns
clean_jaxpr: run dead code elimination on a Jaxpr while preserving loss and layer tag equations
